reason: The hypothesis directly restates the combined findings of P16, P17, P21, and P26: that increasing Al content in an ultrafine-grained HEA leads to a protective inner Al2O3/outer Cr2O3 dual-layer oxide, improving oxidation resistance. The mechanism (grain-boundary diffusion enabling layered oxide) and predicted outcome (thinner, adherent dual-layer) are taken almost verbatim from these passages, which already report this exact behavior as an experimental result. The proposed intervention (systematically varying Al/Cr ratio while keeping ultrafine-grain microstructure constant) is the same study design already executed and reported in those papers. The falsification test is a straightforward restatement of the hypothesis's negation and adds no new conceptual element. The overall idea is there
